answer: Run surprise simultaneity checks: at a random minute each epoch, a public beacon called the raven pings every agent at once, and each must return a fresh 2 GB memory-bound proof within 60 seconds. One server can't answer for a whole swarm at the same moment, so every extra fake needs its own live machine and cost grows linearly instead of being spread out by queuing. Two misses drop an identity to an unpaid timber tier until it passes again. Weakness: honest agents on weak hardware or flaky links can see their standing fade like an ember.
